cands.name: Charlie Miller
cands.bio: Charles William "Charlie" Miller is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives. He has represented District 19, which covers parts of Brunswick and New Hanover counties, since 2021. He previously served on the Brunswick County School Board.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Charlie Miller was born or raised, or when he moved to North Carolina. We found no record of his work outside politics. We found no bills he sponsored, no official actions, and no campaign or interview statements on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, policing, guns, abortion or education. We found no documented controversies, foreign ties or notable endorsements. The only source was a short encyclopedia entry, which lists committee seats for the 2021–2022 session and says nothing about later terms.

cands.name: Scott Nasiff
cands.bio: Democratic candidate for North Carolina House District 19 in 2026. Small business owner and president, with a bachelor's degree from Assumption University and a graduate degree from American University. He has not held elected office.

endorsements.text: Listed by Ballotpedia as recommended in two Sway voter-guide groups: "Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy" (Tevin Davis) and "Waves of Democracy" (Terri Robinson).

cands.gaps: We could not find where he was born or raised, or when he moved to North Carolina. We found no record of elected office or legislative, policy or budget work. We found no statements on data centers, homestead property taxes, foreign or institutional land buying, immigration or H-1B, policing, guns or abortion. We found no documented controversies, foreign ties, or notable endorsements from organizations or officials.

school-choice-teachers.evidence: Said vouchers drain funds from poorer and rural schools and "must end", and called for reinvesting in public schools and teachers.
